prompt.project_info: Create a warm lifestyle fashion portrait in a playful personal bedroom.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long brown hair in high pigtails and large white bows, natural makeup, gentle confident smile, wearing a light-lavender knee-length short-sleeve dress with ruffled trim and opaque pastel-pink tights with a generic cute cat motif.
prompt.composition_elements: Centered medium-to-full-body portrait with a comfortable kneeling or seated-on-heels fashion pose, pink walls, framed art, desk and drawers, chair, soft carpet, plush animals and colorful building blocks in foreground.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Warm indoor light with soft shadows, cozy playful bedroom, clear lifestyle/fashion tone explicitly non-sexualized.
prompt.technical_specs: High-resolution photorealistic portrait, realistic joint articulation, warm indoor color, clear prop detail and natural fabric texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A warm high-resolution photorealistic lifestyle fashion portrait of an approved adult woman with long brown hair in high pigtails secured by large white bows, natural makeup, and a gentle confident smile. She wears a light-lavender short-sleeve knee-length dress with a fitted waist, flared skirt, ruffled trim, and opaque pastel-pink tights with a generic cute cat motif. She holds a comfortable kneeling or seated-on-heels fashion pose on a soft carpet. The playful bedroom has light pink walls, framed art, wooden desk and drawers, an office chair, plush animals, and colorful building blocks in the foreground. Use warm indoor light, soft shadows, realistic articulation, natural fabric, and a clearly non-sexualized lifestyle mood.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, mini dress, exposed thighs, sexualized kneeling pose, fetish framing, trademark character logo, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, bedroom, bows, lavender palette, cute motif, props, and warm light; replace the motif with a generic cat-like pattern and keep typography/logos absent. Maintain non-sexualized pose.

changes: Replaced mini dress and potentially fetishized kneeling framing with a knee-length dress, opaque tights, and an explicitly non-sexualized fashion pose; genericized the character motif.
